overview.headline: Widespread unresolved support and reliability failures driving overwhelmingly negative sentiment (93%) across the entire user base.
overview.summary: All 100 uploaded records remain unresolved and sentiment is heavily negative (93%), with 33% of records explicitly raising support concerns. Product reliability and outages are frequent themes (reliability 14%, hardware 8%, connectivity 6%), and customers report specific failures after updates and missing options. Only 2% of records are explicit feature requests, while 14% contain churn signals. Most contacts come through chat (50%), then email (29%) and calls (21%), indicating heavy inbound support volume and escalation pressure.
overview.priority: Immediate: clear the unresolved-issue backlog by opening a dedicated cross-functional war room (support + engineering) to triage, escalate, and communicate fixes within a defined SLA.

Customers report post-update malfunctions, intermittent failures, data-loss incidents, and missing options that support has not closed, producing repeated, unresolved touchpoints.

feature_request_insight: Feature demand is limited in volume: only 2 records (2%) are classified as feature requests and feature-topics include a single explicit 'feature request' and a data-loss-related request. However, multiple records point to 'missing option' (3 records) and requests around data recovery appear in the churn-topic list, indicating customers want recovery/restore capabilities and particular configuration options that are currently absent or unclear. Treat capability questions about data recovery and missing options as actionable product gaps.
churn_insight: There is meaningful retention risk: 14 records (14%) contain churn signals and those signals cluster around unresolved support (5 churn-topic records), login issues, software bugs, and data loss. The combination of 100 unresolved cases and dominant negative sentiment suggests declining confidence—customers experiencing unresolved bugs, login failures, or data-loss risk are most likely to leave. Prioritize fixing root causes and proactive outreach to affected customers to reduce near-term churn.
suggested_questions: Which feature are customers most complaining about?
Which features should we add to the roadmap, especially where high-profile customers are asking even though request volume is lower?
Which clients are likely to churn and why? Prioritize high-profile customers first.
Which customer problems are causing the most unresolved friction and what should we fix first?
Which customer segments or accounts show the strongest combination of business impact and recurring product pain?
analysis_method: OpenAI analyzed all 100 uploaded records in small internal batches of up to 30 records. Classifications and aggregate counts were calculated across all analyzed records.
